response.sql: WITH race_constructor_results AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, COUNT(cr.raceId) as entry_count, COALESCE(SUM(cr.points), 0) as total_points FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId LEFT JOIN constructorResults cr ON r.raceId = cr.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), average_entries AS (SELECT AVG(entry_count) as avg_count FROM race_constructor_results) SELECT rcr.raceId, rcr.country, rcr.total_points, rcr.entry_count, rcr.entry_count - ae.avg_count as difference_above_average FROM race_constructor_results rcr CROSS JOIN average_entries ae WHERE rcr.entry_count > ae.avg_count ORDER BY difference_above_average DESC LIMIT 10
